title: Enable Claude Code session state events
description:
devhost handles `session_state_changed` (`chat_sessions.go`), but nothing in the repository sets `CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS`, which the SDK docs say enables it. A queued message that starts after a `result` will likely show the session as idle or errored while the agent is working.

Set the variable for Claude Code sessions, and test a message that starts after a `result`. The behavior is inferred from the docs and code, so confirm it before changing the UI.
